CodDesc.name: PRODOTTI_SEGMENTO
CodDesc.whereCondition: CODICE_SEGMENTO = ? AND FLAG_VALIDITA = 'S' order by DESCRIZIONE ASC

Access.name: descrizioneAutocomplete
Access.Query:
select distinct C.CODICE_MODULO , C.DESCRIZIONE from CEPE_CATM_MODULO C , CEPE_CATM_MODULO_PRODOTTO B where not exists (select 1 from PDF_ANAG PA where PA.PDF_ID = C.ID_MODULO and PA.AREA not in ('CATALOGO_MODULI','CATALOGO_OPERAZIONI')) and getdate() between C.VALIDO_DAL and isnull(dateadd(dd,+1,C.VALIDO_FINO_AL),'99990101') and upper(C.CODICE_MODULO) like upper(
%codice%) and ( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace(upper(C.DESCRIZIONE),'[','%') ,']','%') ,'-','%') ,'_','%') ,'/','%') ,'(','%') ,')','%') ,'.','%') ,' ','%') like upper(
%descrizioneForLike%) or str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace(upper(C.CODICE_MODULO),'[','%') ,']','%') ,'-','%') ,'_','%') ,'/','%') ,'(','%') ,')','%') ,'.','%') ,' ','%') like upper(
%descrizioneForLike%) )
and C.CODICE_SEGMENTO =
codiceSegmento and C.ID_MODULO = B.ID_MODULO and B.CODICE_TIPOPRODOTTO =
codiceProdotto and C.CODICE_TIPOMODULO =
codiceTipoModulo order by 1

Access.name: loadDettaglioModulo
Access.Query: select top 1 C.CODICE_MODULO , C.DESCRIZIONE , isnull(TM.DESCRIZIONE,convert(varchar,C.CODICE_TIPOMODULO)) , isnull(TS.DESCRIZIONE,convert(varchar,C.CODICE_SEGMENTO)) , isnull((select P2.START_DATE from PDF_PUBLICATION P2 where (P2.IS_ARCHIVED is null or P2.IS_ARCHIVED = 'N') and P2.PDF_ID = C.ID_MODULO and P2.START_DATE <= getdate() having P2.START_DATE = max(P2.START_DATE) and P2.PUBLISH_TIME = max(P2.PUBLISH_TIME)),C.VALIDO_DAL) , C.VALIDO_FINO_AL , C.FLAG_CONTR_ELETTR , C.FLAG_STAMPA_CONTR_ELETTR , C.FLAG_INTRANET , C.FLAG_CARTA_CHIMICA , C.NOTE_OPERATIVE , AN.MOM_CODE , AN.IS_STAMPA_ENABLED , AN.IS_CARTA_LIBERA_ENABLED , AN.IS_CARTA_CHIMICA_ENABLED , AN.IS_FIRMA_DIGTALE_ENABLED , AN.COD_PRODOTTO_PRIT , AN.COD_OPERAZIONE_PRIT , AN.IS_COPERNICO_ENABLED , (select P2.PUBLICATION_ID from PDF_PUBLICATION P2 where (P2.IS_ARCHIVED is null or P2.IS_ARCHIVED = 'N') and P2.PDF_ID = C.ID_MODULO and P2.START_DATE <= getdate() having P2.START_DATE = max(P2.START_DATE) and P2.PUBLISH_TIME = max(P2.PUBLISH_TIME)) as pdfPubIdCorrente , (select P2.EDITION from PDF_PUBLICATION P2 where (P2.IS_ARCHIVED is null or P2.IS_ARCHIVED = 'N') and P2.PDF_ID = C.ID_MODULO and P2.START_DATE <= getdate() having P2.START_DATE = max(P2.START_DATE) and P2.PUBLISH_TIME = max(P2.PUBLISH_TIME)) as pdfEditionCorrente from CEPE_CATM_MODULO C, CEPE_CATM_TIPOMODULO TM, CEPE_CATM_SEGMENTO TS, PDF_ANAG AN where C.ID_MODULO = ? and C.CODICE_TIPOMODULO *= TM.CODICE_TIPOMODULO and C.CODICE_SEGMENTO *= TS.CODICE_SEGMENTO and C.ID_MODULO *= AN.PDF_ID

Access.name: loadProdottiModulo
Access.Query: select P.DESCRIZIONE from CEPE_CATM_TIPOPRODOTTO P, CEPE_CATM_MODULO_PRODOTTO M where M.CODICE_TIPOPRODOTTO = P.CODICE_TIPOPRODOTTO and P.FLAG_VALIDITA = 'S' and M.ID_MODULO = ? order by P.DESCRIZIONE asc

Access.name: loadPdfApplReferences
Access.Query: select APPL_DESCR from PDF_APPL_REFERENCED_CODE where PDF_CODE = ? or PDF_CODE = ? and APPL_DESCR is not null order by APPL_DESCR asc

Access.name: pdfList
Access.Query:
select distinct C.ID_MODULO as pdfId , C.CODICE_MODULO as pdfCode , C.DESCRIZIONE as pdfDescr , A.IS_STAMPA_ENABLED , A.IS_CARTA_LIBERA_ENABLED , A.IS_CARTA_CHIMICA_ENABLED , A.IS_FIRMA_DIGTALE_ENABLED , A.IS_COPERNICO_ENABLED , (select P2.PUBLICATION_ID from PDF_PUBLICATION P2 where (P2.IS_ARCHIVED is null or P2.IS_ARCHIVED = 'N') and P2.PDF_ID = C.ID_MODULO and P2.START_DATE <= getdate() having P2.START_DATE = max(P2.START_DATE) and P2.PUBLISH_TIME = max(P2.PUBLISH_TIME)) as pdfPubIdCorrente , (select P2.EDITION from PDF_PUBLICATION P2 where (P2.IS_ARCHIVED is null or P2.IS_ARCHIVED = 'N') and P2.PDF_ID = C.ID_MODULO and P2.START_DATE <= getdate() having P2.START_DATE = max(P2.START_DATE) and P2.PUBLISH_TIME = max(P2.PUBLISH_TIME)) as pdfEditionCorrente , (select EX.COMP_EXMP_CONTENT_TYPE from CEPE_CATM_MODULO_COMP_EXMP EX where C.ID_MODULO = EX.ID_MODULO) as pdfCompilationExampleFileType , isnull(TM.DESCRIZIONE,convert(varchar,C.CODICE_TIPOMODULO)) as tipoModulo , isnull(TS.DESCRIZIONE,convert(varchar,C.CODICE_SEGMENTO)) , case when datalength(C.NOTE_OPERATIVE) = 0 then null else '*' end from CEPE_CATM_MODULO C, PDF_ANAG A, CEPE_CATM_TIPOMODULO TM, CEPE_CATM_SEGMENTO TS , CEPE_CATM_MODULO_PRODOTTO B where
C.ID_MODULO = A.PDF_ID
C.ID_MODULO *= A.PDF_ID
and not exists (select 1 from PDF_ANAG PA where PA.PDF_ID = C.ID_MODULO and PA.AREA not in ('CATALOGO_MODULI','CATALOGO_OPERAZIONI')) and getdate() between C.VALIDO_DAL and isnull(dateadd(dd,+1,C.VALIDO_FINO_AL),'99990101') and C.CODICE_TIPOMODULO *= TM.CODICE_TIPOMODULO and C.CODICE_SEGMENTO *= TS.CODICE_SEGMENTO and ( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace(upper(C.DESCRIZIONE),'[','%') ,']','%') ,'-','%') ,'_','%') ,'/','%') ,'(','%') ,')','%') ,'.','%') ,' ','%') like upper(
%descrizioneForLike%) or str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace(upper(C.CODICE_MODULO),'[','%') ,']','%') ,'-','%') ,'_','%') ,'/','%') ,'(','%') ,')','%') ,'.','%') ,' ','%') like upper(
%descrizioneForLike%) )
and C.CODICE_SEGMENTO =
codiceSegmento and C.ID_MODULO = B.ID_MODULO and B.CODICE_TIPOPRODOTTO =
codiceProdotto and C.CODICE_TIPOMODULO =
codiceTipoModulo
and A.IS_FIRMA_DIGTALE_ENABLED = 'S' and (select P2.PUBLICATION_ID from PDF_PUBLICATION P2 where (P2.IS_ARCHIVED is null or P2.IS_ARCHIVED = 'N') and P2.PDF_ID = C.ID_MODULO and P2.START_DATE <= getdate() having P2.START_DATE = max(P2.START_DATE) and P2.PUBLISH_TIME = max(P2.PUBLISH_TIME)) is not null
order by C.CODICE_MODULO asc

Access.name: pdfDraftList
Access.Query:
select I.PDF_INSTANCE_ID , I.PDF_ID , I.CODE , I.PUBLICATION_ID , (select P2.EDITION from PDF_PUBLICATION P2 where P2.PDF_ID = I.PDF_ID and P2.PUBLICATION_ID = I.PUBLICATION_ID) as pdfEdition , I.DESCR , I.CREATION_USER , I.CREATION_TIME , I.STATO , isnull((select M.X_MODALITA_DI_SOTTOSCRIZIONE from PDF_MODALITA_SOTTOSCRIZIONE M where M.MODALITA_DI_SOTTOSCRIZIONE = I.MODALITA_DI_SOTTOSCRIZIONE),isnull(MODALITA_DI_SOTTOSCRIZIONE,'non spec.'))
, I.COD_AGENTE , (select sogg.DENOMINAZIONE from PARC..ARC_ANAG_SOGGETTO sogg WHERE right('0000000000' + sogg.COD_SOGGETTO, 10) = I.COD_AGENTE)null
, I.CLI1_NDG , I.CLI1_ID_CENSIMENTO , I.CLI1_ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE , I.CLI1_COGNOME , I.CLI1_NOME
, I.CLI2_NDG , I.CLI2_ID_CENSIMENTO , I.CLI2_ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE , I.CLI2_COGNOME , I.CLI2_NOME
, I.CLI3_NDG , I.CLI3_ID_CENSIMENTO , I.CLI3_ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE , I.CLI3_COGNOME , I.CLI3_NOME
, I.CLI4_NDG , I.CLI4_ID_CENSIMENTO , I.CLI4_ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE , I.CLI4_COGNOME , I.CLI4_NOME
, I.CLI5_NDG , I.CLI5_ID_CENSIMENTO , I.CLI5_ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE , I.CLI5_COGNOME , I.CLI5_NOME
, I.CLI6_NDG , I.CLI6_ID_CENSIMENTO , I.CLI6_ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE , I.CLI6_COGNOME , I.CLI6_NOME
, I.CLI7_NDG , I.CLI7_ID_CENSIMENTO , I.CLI7_ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE , I.CLI7_COGNOME , I.CLI7_NOME
, I.CLI8_NDG , I.CLI8_ID_CENSIMENTO , I.CLI8_ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE , I.CLI8_COGNOME , I.CLI8_NOME
, I.CLI9_NDG , I.CLI9_ID_CENSIMENTO , I.CLI9_ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE , I.CLI9_COGNOME , I.CLI9_NOME
from PDF_INSTANCE I , CEPE_CATM_MODULO_PRODOTTO B where I.STATO = '01' and (I.CREATION_USER =
contextUserCode or (I.COD_AGENTE =
contextUserCode and I.CREATION_USERTYPE='ASSISTENTEFB')) (I.CREATION_USER =
contextUserCode) (I.COD_AGENTE =
contextCurrentLinkedUserCode and (I.CREATION_USERTYPE='ASSISTENTEFB' or I.CREATION_USERTYPE='RETE')) (1 = 2) and I.ENVIRONMENT = 'prgm.pdfwebforms.catalog.PdfCatalogModel.AREA_CATALOGO_MODULI' and I.PDF_ID = B.ID_MODULO and B.CODICE_TIPOPRODOTTO =
codiceProdotto order by I.CREATION_TIME desc

Access.name: pdfCompletedList
Access.Query:
select I.PDF_INSTANCE_ID , I.PDF_ID , I.CODE , I.PUBLICATION_ID , (select P2.EDITION from PDF_PUBLICATION P2 where P2.PDF_ID = I.PDF_ID and P2.PUBLICATION_ID = I.PUBLICATION_ID) as pdfEdition , I.DESCR , I.COMPLETION_USER , I.COMPLETION_TIME , I.STATO , I.MODALITA_DI_SOTTOSCRIZIONE , isnull((select M.X_MODALITA_DI_SOTTOSCRIZIONE from PDF_MODALITA_SOTTOSCRIZIONE M where M.MODALITA_DI_SOTTOSCRIZIONE = I.MODALITA_DI_SOTTOSCRIZIONE),MODALITA_DI_SOTTOSCRIZIONE) as pdfCompilationModeDescr
, I.COD_AGENTE , (select sogg.DENOMINAZIONE from PARC..ARC_ANAG_SOGGETTO sogg WHERE right('0000000000' + sogg.COD_SOGGETTO, 10) = I.COD_AGENTE)sogg.DENOMINAZIONEnull
, I.CLI1_NDG , I.CLI1_ID_CENSIMENTO , I.CLI1_ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE , I.CLI1_COGNOME , I.CLI1_NOME
, I.CLI2_NDG , I.CLI2_ID_CENSIMENTO , I.CLI2_ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE , I.CLI2_COGNOME , I.CLI2_NOME
, I.CLI3_NDG , I.CLI3_ID_CENSIMENTO , I.CLI3_ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE , I.CLI3_COGNOME , I.CLI3_NOME
, I.CLI4_NDG , I.CLI4_ID_CENSIMENTO , I.CLI4_ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE , I.CLI4_COGNOME , I.CLI4_NOME
, I.CLI5_NDG , I.CLI5_ID_CENSIMENTO , I.CLI5_ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE , I.CLI5_COGNOME , I.CLI5_NOME
, I.CLI6_NDG , I.CLI6_ID_CENSIMENTO , I.CLI6_ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE , I.CLI6_COGNOME , I.CLI6_NOME
, I.CLI7_NDG , I.CLI7_ID_CENSIMENTO , I.CLI7_ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE , I.CLI7_COGNOME , I.CLI7_NOME
, I.CLI8_NDG , I.CLI8_ID_CENSIMENTO , I.CLI8_ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE , I.CLI8_COGNOME , I.CLI8_NOME
, I.CLI9_NDG , I.CLI9_ID_CENSIMENTO , I.CLI9_ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE , I.CLI9_COGNOME , I.CLI9_NOME
from PDF_INSTANCE I , CEPE_CATM_MODULO_PRODOTTO B , PARC..ARC_ANAG_SOGGETTO sogg where I.STATO != '01' and I.ENVIRONMENT = 'prgm.pdfwebforms.catalog.PdfCatalogModel.AREA_CATALOGO_MODULI' and (I.COMPLETION_USER =
contextUserCode or (I.COD_AGENTE =
contextUserCode and I.CREATION_USERTYPE='ASSISTENTEFB')) (1 = 1) (I.COD_AGENTE =
contextCurrentLinkedUserCode and (I.CREATION_USERTYPE='ASSISTENTEFB' or I.CREATION_USERTYPE='RETE')) (1 = 2)
and I.COD_AGENTE = right('0000000000' +
codAgente, 10)
and I.COD_AGENTE = right('0000000000' + sogg.COD_SOGGETTO, 10) and upper(sogg.DENOMINAZIONE) like upper(
%nominativoAgente%)
and (upper(I.CLI1_COGNOME) like upper(
cognomeCliente%) or upper(I.CLI2_COGNOME) like upper(
cognomeCliente%) or upper(I.CLI3_COGNOME) like upper(
cognomeCliente%) or upper(I.CLI4_COGNOME) like upper(
cognomeCliente%) or upper(I.CLI5_COGNOME) like upper(
cognomeCliente%) or upper(I.CLI6_COGNOME) like upper(
cognomeCliente%) or upper(I.CLI7_COGNOME) like upper(
cognomeCliente%) or upper(I.CLI8_COGNOME) like upper(
cognomeCliente%) or upper(I.CLI9_COGNOME) like upper(
cognomeCliente%))
and (upper(I.CLI1_NOME) like upper(
nomeCliente%) or upper(I.CLI2_NOME) like upper(
nomeCliente%) or upper(I.CLI3_NOME) like upper(
nomeCliente%) or upper(I.CLI4_NOME) like upper(
nomeCliente%) or upper(I.CLI5_NOME) like upper(
nomeCliente%) or upper(I.CLI6_NOME) like upper(
nomeCliente%) or upper(I.CLI7_NOME) like upper(
nomeCliente%) or upper(I.CLI8_NOME) like upper(
nomeCliente%) or upper(I.CLI9_NOME) like upper(
nomeCliente%))
and (upper(I.DESCR) like upper(
%descrizione%) or upper(I.CODE) like upper(
%descrizione%))
and I.COMPLETION_TIME >= convert(varchar(8),
dataInizio,112) and I.COMPLETION_TIME < convert(varchar(8),dateadd(dd,+1,
dataFine),112) and I.PDF_ID = B.ID_MODULO and B.CODICE_TIPOPRODOTTO =
codiceProdotto order by I.COMPLETION_TIME desc
